status: posthoc new-provider metadata screen after prior study results; no Hubbard Brook target temperatures read
provider: Hubbard Brook Ecosystem Study catalog and its linked EDI metadata
scope: Inspect catalog and metadata only for measured in-stream temperature time series; explicitly distinguish air/soil/lake temperature and weekly chemistry from continuous stream thermometry. Do not download temperature data or fit models in this step.
feasibility: Require metadata encompassing at least five full calendar years with subdaily sampling and an interpretable timestamp convention and per-value estimation/quality policy before a later separately documented strict-reference intake. Four other complete history years would satisfy the original numerical-release history gate; date-span feasibility alone is not qualification.
prior_contact: Provider-specific station identifiers, coordinates and watershed overlap must be compared with all source/prior archives before any model-scoring claim; a new provider does not establish new climate or independence.
stop_rule: If metadata does not identify an eligible candidate or cannot be accessed, report unavailable/unknown; do not relax the rule or score an ineligible series. Coweeta HydroShare 2017-2019 spans only three calendar years and is not pursued for this five-year screen.
limits: No provider contact, registration, publication, temperature-outcome inspection or general climate/quality claim is authorised by this metadata screen.
